headline: Iran demands emergency UN Security Council meeting over US MOAB threat and Israeli energy-infrastructure threats
dek: Iran urges the UNSC to hold an emergency meeting and condemn: (a) possible US use of the GBU-43/B MOAB against Iran — citing Oct 15 US media reports that the White House/Pentagon prepared options including MOAB, and Trump's televised Oct 15 discussion of the weapon/threats of further strikes; (b)…
sources: Gholamhossein Darzi, Iran's Ambassador and Deputy Permanent Representative to the UN (formal letter to UN Secretary-General and Security Council president)
fault_line: 'Finish the job' with the Mother of All Bombs — Trump floats the biggest conventional bomb ever, Iran runs to the Security Council. Deterrence theater, or is the next strike actually being planned?

sections.what_happened: Iran urges the UNSC to hold an emergency meeting and condemn: (a) possible US use of the GBU-43/B MOAB against Iran — citing Oct 15 US media reports that the White House/Pentagon prepared options including MOAB, and Trump's televised Oct 15 discussion of the weapon/threats of further strikes; (b) Israel's declared intent to target Iran's entire energy infrastructure (Minister for military affairs Israel Katz: prepared to attack and hit 'all energy facilities'; 'return Iran to the Stone Age'; claimed US+Israel dropped 35,000 bombs); (c) Netanyahu's declared intention to launch another war. Warns of 'catastrophic humanitarian consequences' and further escalation; says silence/emboldening by certain Council members; full responsibility on US/Israel and enablers.
sections.what_verified: Tasnim (full text), ISNA (full text), PressTV, ET Now, ABNA, pakistantv live blog. Context: Trump's 'finish the job' warning reported by multiple outlets (daijiworld, TRT World re Oct 19 Truth Social posts).
sections.what_disputed: US media reports of Oct 15 MOAB options are cited second-hand in the letter — this scan did not re-verify the original Oct 15 reports. No UNSC meeting scheduled yet.
sections.why_matters: Iran put Trump's own words on the record at the United Nations: the 'mother of all bombs,' Katz's 'return Iran to the Stone Age.' Tehran's play is the law — the Security Council floor — while the threat is a 21,600-pound bomb. Iran-side framing: when the threats are this explicit, silence from the Council IS a position.
sections.context: Background: Iran demands emergency UN Security Council meeting over US MOAB threat and Israeli energy-infrastructure threats

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran put Trump's own words on the record at the United Nations: the 'mother of all bombs,' Katz's 'return Iran to the Stone Age.' Tehran's play is the law — the Security Council floor — while the threat is a 21,600-pound bomb. Iran-side framing: when the threats are this explicit, silence from the Council IS a position. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 'Finish the job' with the Mother of All Bombs — Trump floats the biggest conventional bomb ever, Iran runs to the Security Council. Deterrence theater, or is the next strike actually being planned?
